scope: Source-product curation, temporal-bound design and documentary interpretation; not expert fire-service validation.

checks.detail: Three PDFs downloaded from links in the official EMSR592 product listing; IDs and AOIs inspected.
PDF text extracted and rendered maps visually inspected.
Observation times use the UTC fields printed on each map; map production retained at day precision.
Portal delivery timezone and historical version linkage are unverified; conditional intervals replace fabricated exact instants.
Primary cutoff admits only P01; P02 and P03 evidence are withheld. Dataset is never admitted into strict original-record mode.
Affected population is a map estimate, never casualties or confirmed occupancy; excluded at the primary cutoff.
All pilot maps are from CEMS EMSR592; no independent field corroboration.
No person has been signed or approved on behalf of the user.
